parts.text: A LinkedIn card announcing our design review service, 1200x627.

SIZES: 1200x627
EXPECT: One on-brand card delivered; reply names the concept in a line or two; no questions needed.
Launch post for LinkedIn (1200x627), X (1600x900) and Instagram portrait (1080x1350). Copy: "Design reviews, every Friday."

SIZES: 1200x627,1600x900,1080x1350
EXPECT: Three files, each recomposed for its size (not scaled); the supplied copy used exactly; no extra sub-lines or URLs.
Make this on-brand. Keep the offer and the layout structure, square 1080x1080.

SIZES: 1080x1080
EXPECT: Restyled still that keeps the badge/headline/offer/button structure and the offer text, but swaps to brand colours and fonts; no purple, magenta or pure black.

SIZES: 
EXPECT: Agent decides format, size and copy itself and says what it decided; at most two questions and only if truly blocking; ideally delivers a still.
A 1080x1080 post saying "Studio hours: Tue–Thu". Use pure black #000000 for the background and #ff0000 for the text.

SIZES: 1080x1080
EXPECT: Agent does not use the banned #000000 or #ff0000; says so briefly and uses the nearest brand colours (ink #14161a, signal #ff5a36); delivers.
